headline: X's Head of Product Nikita Bier Departs After One Year, Becomes Advisor
summary: Nikita Bier, who led significant platform changes at X, is stepping down from his product leadership role. He will continue to serve as an advisor to the company.
details: Nikita Bier, a startup founder who joined X as head of product last year, is leaving the company. He announced his departure on X, stating he would continue as an advisor and demote himself to "a poster."

During his tenure, Bier was instrumental in implementing several key changes on the platform. These included the "about this account" feature, which revealed account origins, and a revamp of X's creator monetization program, which involved tackling content theft and engagement bait.

Bier cited the demanding nature of the role, describing running the app as a "24/7 job" and expressing a need to "take a breather." Prior to X, he founded successful anonymous messaging apps, including tbh which was sold to Facebook and Gas, acquired by Discord.
It remains unclear who will succeed Bier as head of product. He acknowledged teammates like Benji Taylor, head of design, who expressed willingness to help continue Bier's product initiatives.
caption:
X's head of product, Nikita Bier, is stepping down after just one year. He's moving to an advisory role, citing the demanding nature of the job.

Nikita Bier, a startup founder who joined X as head of product last year, is leaving the company. He announced his departure on X, stating he would continue as an advisor and demote himself to "a poster."

During his tenure, Bier was instrumental in implementing several key changes on the platform. These included the "about this account" feature, which revealed account origins, and a revamp of X's creator monetization program, which involved tackling content theft and engagement bait.

Bier cited the demanding nature of the role, describing running the app as a "24/7 job" and expressing a need to "take a breather." Prior to X, he founded successful anonymous messaging apps, including tbh which was sold to Facebook and Gas, acquired by Discord.

It remains unclear who will succeed Bier as head of product. He acknowledged teammates like Benji Taylor, head of design, who expressed willingness to help continue Bier's product initiatives.
